detailed_description:
 目标视频为明亮彩色写实视频风格，竖屏9:16。

 安静酒吧房间底噪，伴随跺脚落地的清脆声响与换装瞬间的轻微衣物拂动声。

nodes.title: Reference video → control signal
widgets_values:
## Reference control signal

The reference video is turned into a guide by an **annotator**. **Depth** (VideoDepthAnything) is wired by default.

## To switch:

connect **Canny** (`CannyEdgePreprocessor`) or **Pose** (`DWPreprocessor`) output into the `input` of the *scale-to-multiple* Resize node instead of the Depth output. All three read the resized reference frames; only the one wired into that Resize is used.
